patch_description: This edit replaces the fixed-threshold, fixed-size logic with a context-aware asymmetric signal engine. It uses predicted_return as the base edge, then tightens or loosens entry criteria using microstructure quality (spread, OBI, book pressure, Kyle lambda), volatility regime (ATR, vol ratios, bb_pct), trend confirmation, funding pressure, and session timing. Position size is scaled by edge quality and penalized in noisy/high-cost regimes. Take-profit, stop-loss, and max_bars are adapted to volatility and expected regime persistence. This should improve Sharpe and Calmar by reducing trades in adverse conditions while keeping larger exposure when multiple signals align.
